creator: Boilerplate
units: px at canvas size; scales are fractions (1 = 100%); times in seconds unless the key ends in Ms; levels in dB relative to the voice

anchors.top: y is the top edge of the element's box, including any text box padding and outline. Text grows downward.
anchors.center: y is the vertical center of the element's box. Text grows up and down equally.
anchors.bottom: y is the bottom edge of the element's box. Text grows upward.
anchors.free: Position chosen per shot within the element's rules.

classic.resolvedNote: The font picked when the kit was last checked on the creator's machine, not a promise. Re-resolve against what's installed.

sizeSmallWhen.note: Set at size; if it wraps past 3 lines, use sizeSmall instead of adding a line.

box.perLineNote: One box behind each line, hugging that line's text; not one box around the block.

must.text: On screen from frame 0, for at least the first 2.5–3 s.
Top half: between y=250 and y=960.
Clear of the right rail.
Never over the face.
Max 3 lines.
One title per video.

startingPoint: Classic IG font: Instagram Sans Bold if installed, else Figtree Bold, 88px, or 72px for long hooks.
Black type on a white bar behind each line, rounded corners. No tilt.
notes: Drop to the small size before adding a fourth line.

aboveHead.when: Default. The speaker is low in frame or there's no face in the middle: greenscreen, wide shots, vlog voiceover.

belowChin.when: The face fills the middle of the frame, so aboveHead would cover it. Judge from the frame; move down, never up over the face.

motion.note: Cut on with the words. No bounce.

must.text: Never over the face, from the hairline to the chin.
Last line ends above y=1460.
Clear of the right rail.
Clear of the title, images, and the plate's key content.
Words come from the transcript, checked against the audio.

startingPoint: Classic IG font: Instagram Sans Bold if installed, else Figtree Bold, 64px, white, 10px black outline.
Every word the same: no highlighted or colored words.
2–3 words per caption clip, one line, broken on phrases.
Cut on with the words. No bounce.

must.text: Bias to the middle of the frame. Move only as far as needed to keep the subject or face visible.
Inside the safe zones.
Never over the face.
Readable with the sound off: the text alone carries the point.

startingPoint: Native caption look: Instagram Sans if installed, else Figtree, 56px, white, thin 6px black outline. Centered, sentence case.
One Shot: long, 3–8 lines. 10 Shot: short, 1–2 lines or a short list of a few words per line.
Listicle: a bigger overlay-style headline right before a numbered list, set as one left-aligned block.
No highlighted words, no background box.

full.label: Full bleed
full.note: Cut to the image, flat. Speaker returns between images.

above.label: Above the speaker
above.note: Almost full width, filling the space above the head. Works on wider shots.

over.label: Over the speaker
over.note: Half the screen or more, in the top half, briefly covering the face.

must.text: One placement for the whole video.
Never covers the title. While the title is on screen, an image sits clear of it or waits until it's gone.
Only Over the speaker covers the face, and only briefly. Full bleed replaces the shot.
Real things are real photos. Never a generated lookalike.

startingPoint: Plain: square corners, no edge, no shadow, no tilt. Treatment is the creator's call.
One image at a time. Cut in, cut out.

must.text: The speaker never covers the background's key content.
Backgrounds fill the frame. No borders, no letterbox.
Hard cuts between backgrounds. No transitions.

startingPoint: Speaker low in frame, head about y=870, clear of the captions. Corner and chaos: 65% size.
No edge or shadow on the speaker.
notes: Side per shot comes from the greenscreen skill: alternate left and right, away from the plate's key content.

real.label: Real object
real.prompt: Photograph of [OBJECT] as a real product shot. One complete object, centered, generous padding, even studio light, sharp focus. Transparent background. No text, logos, shadows, floor, or props.

illustration.label: Illustration
illustration.prompt: Flat illustration of [OBJECT]. Bold simple shapes, thick dark outline, palette of [BRAND COLORS]. One object, centered, generous padding. Transparent background. No text, no shadow.

hand-drawn.label: Hand drawn
hand-drawn.prompt: Hand-drawn marker sketch of [OBJECT]. Black marker lines with one [ACCENT] highlight, loose but readable, like a quick whiteboard doodle. Transparent background. No text.

motion.timing: on the word that names it

must.text: One style, one locked prompt. Same prompt every time.
Transparent PNG. No text in the image.
Clean cutout. Nothing baked in: no edge, shadow, or tilt.
Never over the speaker or the face. Sits in empty space beside or above them, inside the safe zones.

startingPoint: Same look and motion as images. No tilt.
About 300–500px. One at a time, max 2 on screen.
Cut in on the word that names it.
Can pair with its caption line, or with a one- or two-word emphasis label in the title style.

sfx.levelNote: levelDb is relative to the voice's peak level.

musicBed.levelNote: levelDb is the bed's level relative to the voice. duckDb applies on top of it while the voice is speaking: -22 in gaps, -22 + -6 = -28 under speech.

referenceFrames.note: Stock placeholder frames until the creator's own are in. Set placeholder to false when a real frame replaces one.

changelog.change: Schema v2: defined anchors, check ids and type, motion, image and object geometry, preference numbers, captions and overlays kept clear of the right rail
Title box ends at x=930 (clear of the right rail), so titles drop to 88px (72px small) to keep two-line hooks on two lines; images never cover the title; duckDb defined; placeholder frames marked
